title: August 25, 2026
summary: GET /v1/studies/:id/participants now returns a moderator object (user_id, name, email) for each participant, so API and MCP consumers can see who is running a session without a second lookup. The field is nullable and returns null when no moderator is assigned. The user_id matches the id returned by GET /v1/interviews/:id/moderators, so you can join the two endpoints directly.
body_markdown:
### Moderator in the participants API


` GET /v1/studies/:id/participants` now returns a` moderator` object for each participant, so you can see who is running a session without a second lookup. The field is available to all API and MCP consumers.


` moderator` is` null` when the participant has no moderator assigned. The` user_id` matches the` user_id` returned by` GET /v1/interviews/:id/moderators` , so you can join the two endpoints directly. See the[API reference](https://developer.greatquestion.co/reference/overview) for the full participant schema.
